geometry.simplification: Douglas-Peucker, tolerance 0.02 deg (~2.2 km); 53-probe acceptance re-run unchanged

known_limitations: Topology (checked 2026-11-13, shapely 2.2.0): 29/35 features fully valid; 6 invalid -- 5 only via degenerate interior rings/holes collapsed by simplification (Austria-Hungary, German Reich, Belgium, Switzerland, Netherlands; exterior rings valid) plus zero-area sliver parts, and 1 self-intersecting island ring (Italian Islands of the Aegean, 0.28 deg2). No visual defect observed at the Europe frame scale. Repair requires re-issuing the derived checksum and re-running the 53 probes; see verification_report.json.
Spain-Portugal 'Modern border' ways use a modern IGN CNIG survey line, unverified against a 1914 source (outside the Ep1 map frame).
Border-line precision between probe points unverified; only containment at 53 points was checked.
Finland modeled within the Russian Empire (no separate Grand Duchy polygon); a distinct Finland label is a presentation decision.
Live-database drift: only the pinned extract (hash above) is verified; a re-query requires re-verification.
License tags on member NODES unchecked (nodes in boundary relations do not normally carry license tags).
license: CC0 dedication (OpenHistoricalMap) + CC BY 4.0 segments (273 member ways; see ATTRIBUTION.md)
valid_note: Relations filtered to those whose start_date <= 1914-07-28 < end_date (start of WWI). Balkan relations encode the post-Balkan-Wars settlement (Treaty of Bucharest, Aug 1913).
